decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the submitted plans Unnumbered, undated, received 21/12/12 approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the hardstanding is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The hardstanding hereby approved shall be constructed of a porous material and shall not be replaced in the future by anything other than a porous material.
Condition : 5 - The crossover hereby approved shall be a minimum of 2.4m wide and a maximum of 3.6m wide.
description: Formation of a vehicle access and hardstanding on the forecourt
